posts.name: Vedant goyal
posts.cooked:
I want to confirm like if I fail in oppe 1st attempt like getting 20 or 30 or even worse then I got another chance to give oppe on 23 and if i score 90 then this 90 score will be considered

Thank you

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: If you get score >= 40 then you will not get another attempt. If it is < 40 then only you will get another chance.

posts.name: Vedant goyal
posts.cooked: ok and In case of 1st failure ,The score I recieved in 2nd attempt will be considered for total score irrespective of my 1st score

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Yes the score you recieve in 2nd attempt will be considered for total score
